dedupe_keys.name: occupation des parcs de stationnement metropolitains

description: Occupation des Parcs de Stationnement Métropolitains is a dataset listed in opendata.clermontmetropole.eu open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SAGS, INDIGO, EFFIA. Ce jeu de données fournit en temps réel le taux d’occupation des places véhicules légers dans les parcs de stationnement à barrières situés dans la métropole. La mise à jour des données s'effectue en moyenne chaque minute, sous réserve de possibles interruptions (ex: panne technique). Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are Parking, Stationnement, Mobilité, Occupation, Clermont AuvergneMétropole. The portal shows 13 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermontmetropole-eu-portal.
